name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 + their Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor.
effect: A protective field of force: while you wear no body armour, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier, for 8 hours.
notes: AC becomes 13 + DEX for 8 hours while you wear no body armour (a shield still adds). Shows on the Equipment tab.
Cast it in the morning; it lasts the day's road.
